title: Chemical Drain Cleaners: Myth vs. Fact
description: Many homeowners and inexperienced maintenance personnel assume pouring liquid chemical drain cleaners down a clogged sink is a quick, safe fix. In reality, strong chemical cleaners can generate intense heat during reactions, softening or warping plastic pipes, eroding older cast iron, and damaging pipe seals. Furthermore, if the chemical fails to clear the obstruction, it leaves a standing pool of corrosive liquid that poses a severe chemical burn hazard to service plumbers who must physically clear the line later. Mechanical drain clearing methods like augers or hydro-jetting are far safer and more reliable.

Chemical Drain Cleaners: Myth vs. Fact

Many homeowners and inexperienced maintenance personnel assume pouring liquid chemical drain cleaners down a clogged sink is a quick, safe fix. In reality, strong chemical cleaners can generate intense heat during reactions, softening or warping plastic pipes, eroding older cast iron, and damaging pipe seals. Furthermore, if the chemical fails to clear the obstruction, it leaves a standing pool of corrosive liquid that poses a severe chemical burn hazard to service plumbers who must physically clear the line later. Mechanical drain clearing methods like augers or hydro-jetting are far safer and more reliable.
